Folding the P3×Pn half-turn gives odd center-column seam masks (0,1,4) with vector u_o, and even between-column seam masks (0,2,5,7) with minus signs for paired upper/lower seam orbit; these exhaust edge-orbit conflicts. The explicit 8×8 signed transfer T_{A,B}=(-1)^|B|(1−1_{upper-free}−1_{lower-free}) for disjoint masks yields s_m=e0^T T^m u. Independently recomputed both first 9 sequences, verified the order-six denominator recurrence for 14 indices and used Cayley–Hamilton order≤8 to extend the vanishing sequence to all m, establishing the exact rational generating functions. The identity and two reflection traces average to quotient reduced Euler; independent exact transfer gives F17=320,F8=94,b8(o)=-22,a17=0, hence (-320+94+22)/4=-51. Independently counted actual edge-orbit matchings for n=2..6, including orientation signs for R,C,RC, which agreed. Finite orbit checks corroborate only, not prove recurrence.
